title: projectMemory
description: A project's memory/ directory (under input/code-agents/<room>/<project>/, the repo-owned store transport populates) as one JSON datum — memory.json, written by memory_to_json.py. The memory contract: an index (MEMORY.md, one entry line per fact) plus one markdown file per fact, each carrying YAML frontmatter (name, description, metadata) and a body that may [[link]] other facts by name. The datum holds that contract to account: every fact carries its identity and classification; index lines that are not entries (headings, the merge marker comments agent.py's receive writes) are carried verbatim as unparsed — data, not discarded. facts may be empty: one observed project's memory/ is a guard-only MEMORY.md with no fact files.

ProjectMemory.title: ProjectMemory
ProjectMemory.description: One project's whole memory state: the project it belongs to, its facts, and its index.

project.description: The project directory name the memory belongs to — the harness's cwd encoding, e.g. '-Users-khalidkhan-dev-github-rpus-claude-export-yoga'.

facts.description: Every fact file (*.md except MEMORY.md), in filename order. May be empty (observed: a guard-only memory/).

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: One memory fact: a frontmattered markdown file. The name is the identity (the [[link]] target vocabulary); the filename is dressing — usually the name plus '.md', but a receive merge re-dresses a diverged twin as <stem>.<room>.md while its name stays.

name.description: The frontmatter name — a short kebab-case slug, the fact's identity and what [[links]] resolve against.

description.description: The frontmatter description — the one-line summary recall uses to judge relevance.

body.description: The fact body after the frontmatter, stripped.

links.description: The distinct [[link]] targets in the body, sorted — the names of related facts (a target need not exist yet; it marks something worth writing).

Index.title: Index
Index.description: MEMORY.md parsed: the entry lines, and everything else verbatim.

file.description: Always MEMORY.md — the index's one prescribed name.

entries.description: The '- [Title](file.md) — hook' lines, in file order. May be empty (the guard-only memory/).

unparsed.description: Every other non-blank line verbatim, in file order: the heading, agent.py's merge marker comments, and any prose (the guard-only memory/ is all prose).

Metadata.title: Metadata
Metadata.description: The fact's frontmatter metadata block. Every observed fact carries all three keys; the harness stamps node_type and originSessionId when a session writes a fact.

node_type.description: The memory system's node discriminator — 'memory' is the only observed value; a new value fails loudly rather than sliding through a bare string.

type.description: The fact's classification — the memory format's four prescribed classes, exhaustive by design: user (who the user is), feedback (guidance on how to work), project (ongoing work and constraints), reference (pointers to external resources). Observed locally: feedback, reference, project.

originSessionId.description: The uuid of the session that wrote the fact — harness-stamped provenance.

file.description: The fact file the entry points to.

hook.description: The one-line reminder after the em dash; '' where the line carries none.

UuidV4.title: UuidV4
UuidV4.description: Standard UUID version 4 (randomly generated). Pattern: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx where y is 8, 9, a, or b.
